start.title: Junior Astronaut
start.subtitle: 30 days on the Moon
start.story: You are the commander of Moon base "Tranquility" in the Sea of Tranquility. Every game day is a real day of space weather from the NASA archive (April 17 – May 16, 2024).
start.noSafe: There is no safe choice: what you take from one place, you lose in another.

evac.title: Crew evacuated!
evac.reasonDose: Too much radiation. Replay a day and hide!
evac.reasonLife: The food ran out. Replay a day and take care of it!

launch.title: Departure day!
launch.lira: The rocket is ready! Fly now or wait?

menu.title: MOONSHIFT
menu.pitch_a: Fly to the Moon and live 30 days at Tranquility Base through the
menu.pitch_b: of spring 2024. Keep the crew safe and bring everyone home!
menu.hello: Hi! I'm Lira from Mission Control. Everything you'll see is from NASA's real records. Ready?
menu.welcomeBack: Welcome back, commander! The Sun has been busy. Shall we go on with Day {n}?
menu.finished: You brought the crew home! Take a look at your star path.
menu.footData: Space weather: NASA DONKI, April 17 – May 16, 2024
menu.footPrivacy: No accounts, no tracking: progress stays in this browser.

path.title: Star path
path.finaleGoal: 🚀 Warm up the rocket and fly to Earth
path.doseLimit: At {n} Mission Control sends the crew home.
path.launchToast: Your rocket left Earth and landed at the base. 30 real days of space weather are ahead!
path.homeToast: Get through all 30 days to fly home.
path.tipStart: Each star is one real day of 2024. Get through all 30 and fly home!
path.tipNight: Lunar night: no solar power. Save your battery!
path.tipStorm: Storm week! Hide in the shelter when the Sun gets angry.
